card.name: Units and abbreviations inside tables and brackets
card.fires_on: Short unit or abbreviation pieces in dosing tables and formulas, such as mL, the start of CrCl, or a single letter like C or O inside brackets. It often fires on the first letter of an abbreviation or on a repeated mL column header.

modes.label: mL in table headers
modes.description: The unit mL repeated as column headings or in parentheses in dosing tables.

modes.label: Start of abbreviations
modes.description: A letter or two that begins an abbreviation such as CrCl, CT2 or cUTI.

modes.label: Single-letter variables
modes.description: A variable letter in a dosing formula or a footnote marker.
